name: People's Zoom Readers Theater
tagline: Fight prejudice and injustice together through drama
intro: We are the People’s Zoom Readers Theater (PZRT), a diverse group that comes together to focus on issues affecting our society, humanity, and democracy. We use drama as our vehicle to unite us in a productive and creative way.

We enjoy sharing our performances with YOU, our audience, in the hope of bringing attention to topics worth discussing—issues that may benefit from action, a change in thinking, or even a change in behavior.
Above all, we aim to provide a venue for those who wish to share their thoughts on critical topics.
contactAlt: PZRT artwork: We Care as We Share What is Behind the Pandemic Mask
contactText: Get in touch with People's Zoom Readers Theater to learn more about our work and how you can get involved.
